patch.summary:
Choose BMC Helix ITSM only if your buying job matches “Enterprise ITSM (Helix / Remedy lineage) — no BMC.com list; AppExchange signal ~$114.75/na” rather than incident.io's shape. Choose incident.io only if your buying job matches “Incident response — Basic Free; Team $15/user/mo annual ($19 monthly); Pro $25/user; on-ca” rather than BMC Helix ITSM's shape. Workflow advantage: BMC Helix ITSM leans itsm-service-desk; incident.io leans incident-oncall. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: BMC Helix ITSM is Enterprise ITSM (Helix / Remedy lineage) — no BMC.com list; AppExchange signal ~$114.75/named user/mo. Always RFP. Does not outrank ServiceN; incident.io is Incident response — Basic Free; Team $15/user/mo annual ($19 monthly); Pro $25/user; on-call add-on +$10–$20/user. Does not outrank PagerDut.
- Company-size focus: BMC Helix ITSM (mid-market, enterprise) vs incident.io (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: BMC Helix ITSM-leaning itsm-service-desk vs incident.io-leaning incident-oncall.
- Researched limits: BMC Helix ITSM — No BMC.com price card — $115 is an AppExchange named-user signal, not a vendor SKU; incident.io — On-call paging is an add-on (+$10–$20/user), not included in the $15 Team floor.

Limitations — BMC Helix ITSM: No BMC.com price card — $115 is an AppExchange named-user signal, not a vendor SKU; Does not outrank ServiceNow (8.7); incident.io: On-call paging is an add-on (+$10–$20/user), not included in the $15 Team floor; Does not outrank PagerDuty (8.0) as the incident-oncall award.

Poor-fit cases: BMC Helix ITSM is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No BMC.com price card — $115 is an AppExchange named-user signal, not a vendor SKU · incident.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: On-call paging is an add-on (+$10–$20/user), not included in the $15 Team floor · Avoid BMC Helix ITSM if you actually need incident.io's motion (Incident response — Basic Free; Team $15/user/mo annual ($19 monthly); Pro $25/u)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
